completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-54-2023-COMPULSORY-EDUCATION-ACT-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2023.pdf》（2 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Compulsory Education Act !Amendment) 2023 and shall commence on 1st January 2024. of section 2 of Chapter 211

Section 2 of the Compulsory Education Act is amended - (a} in the definition of "child of compulsory school age" - li) by deleting "6" from the first line and by substituting "5" therefor; Iii) by deleting "primary and lower" from the third line and by substituting "pre-school, primary and" therefor; {b) in the definition of "Government school", by deleting "primary or lower" from the second line and by substituting "pre-school, primary or" therefor. Made this 16th. day of Jamadilawal, 1445 Hijriah corresponding to the 30th. day of November, 2023 at Our Istana Nurul !man, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, DARUSSALAM.
